## Executive Summary

This report analyzes quarterly sales data for Q1-Q4 2024. Total revenue reached **$2.4M**, representing a 15% increase year-over-year.

## Data Analysis

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Quarterly sales data (in thousands)
quarters = ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4']
revenue = [520, 580, 650, 650]
costs = [320, 350, 380, 390]
profit = [r - c for r, c in zip(revenue, costs)]

# Calculate key metrics
total_revenue = sum(revenue)
total_profit = sum(profit)
profit_margin = (total_profit / total_revenue) * 100

print(f"Total Revenue: ${total_revenue}K")
print(f"Total Profit: ${total_profit}K")
print(f"Average Profit Margin: {profit_margin:.1f}%")
```

The analysis shows that our average profit margin for 2024 was `{python} f"{profit_margin:.1f}%"`, with total profit of `{python} f"${total_profit}K"`.

## Quarterly Performance

```{python}
#| label: fig-quarterly
#| fig-cap: "Quarterly Revenue, Costs, and Profit"

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

x = np.arange(len(quarters))
width = 0.25

ax.bar(x - width, revenue, width, label='Revenue', color='#2E86AB')
ax.bar(x, costs, width, label='Costs', color='#A23B72')
ax.bar(x + width, profit, width, label='Profit', color='#F18F01')

ax.set_xlabel('Quarter')
ax.set_ylabel('Amount ($K)')
ax.set_title('2024 Quarterly Financial Performance')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(quarters)
ax.legend()
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

Q4 showed the strongest performance with revenue of $650K and profit of `{python} f"${profit[3]}K"`, maintaining our highest profit margin of the year.

## Summary Statistics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total Revenue | $2.4M |
| Total Profit | $1.0M |
| Avg Profit Margin | 42.5% |
| Best Quarter | Q3/Q4 (tied) |

## Recommendations

Based on the analysis, we recommend:

1. Maintain cost control strategies that achieved the 42.5% profit margin
2. Invest in scaling operations to sustain Q3/Q4 revenue levels
3. Focus on customer retention to build on strong Q4 performance
